payload.title: Object deletes not broadcast over sync gateway (clients keep stale rows)
payload.description:
## Symptom
When an object is deleted on the server, other connected clients do NOT drop the row live — they only lose it on the next cold refetch. Every other mutation (objectUpsert, streamAppend) fans out over the sync gateway; delete silently does not.

## Root cause (confirmed in Frick source)
- apps/server/src/store.ts deleteObject() (~line 785) returns the delete result WITHOUT calling #notifyWriteListener — unlike writeObject, which notifies on every upsert.
- The FrickStoreWriteEvent union has no `objectDelete` kind (only objectUpsert / streamAppend).
- apps/server/src/sync/gateway.ts has no objectDelete handling and no publishObjectDeletes.

Verified still missing from upstream Frick source as of this writing.

## Current downstream workaround (fragile — should be retired by this fix)
RangerCRM carries a local patch-package patch against the COMPILED dist: /Users/bri/dev/RangerCRM/server/patches/@fricken+server+0.1.1.patch. It (a) adds an objectDelete write-event + notify in store.js deleteObject, and (b) adds publishObjectDeletes in gateway.js that emits the removed id both as a tombstone record (the existing FrickSwift SDK decodes it -> .objectsDelta -> refetch drops the row) AND as a clean `removed: [{type,id}]` list (forward-compat for a future JS client), tenant-scoped, reusing the upsert packer. Patching dist/ is brittle and invisible to other Frick apps.

## Proposed upstream fix (port the patch into source, properly)
1. Add `objectDelete` to the FrickStoreWriteEvent union (store.ts ~line 236).
2. Have deleteObject() call #notifyWriteListener({ kind: "objectDelete", tenantId, objectType, objectId }) when a row actually existed (parity with the upsert path).
3. Add SyncGateway.publishObjectDeletes(type, ids, tenantId) and route the objectDelete write-event to it — emit both the tombstone Delta frame (SDK back-compat) and a `removed` list.
4. Add a test: two subscribed clients, delete on one, assert the other receives a Delta/removed for the id.

## Why generic / belongs upstream
Every Frick app that deletes objects needs live delete fan-out. This is framework infrastructure, not RangerCRM domain. Landing it upstream lets RangerCRM delete its patch-package patch entirely (and drops the patch-package/postinstall-postinstall dev deps from rangercrm-server).
